name: Under The Full Bright Moon
source:
Thrown into a world of magic and mystery, Feenyx finds himself confronting big problems and even bigger werewolves! He soon meets Bowers, a stoic wolf with a difficult past. As the new human in town, discover just what this world has in store for you, and make your mark on it in turn.

[From [url=https://museproductionsteam.itch.io/under-the-bright-full-moon]Itch.io[/url]]
